title: Improving students’ reading, comprehension, and reading motivation through texts generated from their prompts using ChatGPT-4: a mixed-method study
core_idea: Investigate whether texts generated by ChatGPT-4 from students' own prompts can be used as an instructional resource to support reading skills, reading comprehension, and reading motivation among 4th-grade primary students; evaluated using a sequential explanatory mixed-method design (Solomon four-group experimental design for quantitative data and a case study for qualitative data) with 106 students in two public schools in Bursa, Türkiye.
tldr: Study examines using ChatGPT-4 to produce student-prompted texts as a classroom tool to enhance reading, comprehension, and motivation in 4th graders, assessed via a mixed-method (Solomon four-group + case study) design with 106 participants.
